votes.sql:
SELECT p.player_name,
       MIN(pa.date) AS contract_start_date,
       MAX(pa.date) AS contract_end_date
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_name;

-- Note: This database schema does not contain contract start date or contract end date columns. 
-- The following query returns player names and their birthday as the only date information available per player.
SELECT p.player_name, p.birthday
FROM "Player" p;

)
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    c.name AS country_name,
    AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_annual_salary
FROM player_match pm
JOIN "Player" p ON p.player_api_id = pm.player_api_id
JOIN "Player_Attributes" pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN "Match" m ON m.match_api_id = pm.match_api_id
JOIN "League" l ON l.id = m.league_id
JOIN "Country" c ON c.id = l.country_id
GROUP BY l.name, c.name;

WITH premier_matches AS (
        SELECT m.*
        FROM "Match" m
        JOIN "League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
        WHERE l.name = 'Premier League'
    ),
    home_contrib AS (
        SELECT season, home_player_1   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_2   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_3   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_4   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_5   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_6   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_7   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_8   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_9   AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_10  AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, home_player_11  AS player_id, home_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches
    ),
    away_contrib AS (
        SELECT season, away_player_1   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_2   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_3   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_4   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_5   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_6   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_7   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_8   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_9   AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_10  AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches UNION ALL
        SELECT season, away_player_11  AS player_id, away_team_goal   AS goals FROM premier_matches
    ),
    player_season_goals AS (
        SELECT player_id,
               season,
               SUM(goals) AS total_goals
        FROM (
            SELECT * FROM home_contrib
            UNION ALL
            SELECT * FROM away_contrib
        )
        GROUP BY player_id, season
    )
SELECT p.player_name,
       psg.season,
       psg.total_goals
FROM player_season_goals psg
JOIN "Player" p ON p.player_api_id = psg.player_id
ORDER BY psg.season, psg.total_goals DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH coach_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_api_id AS coach_id,
        l.id AS league_id,
        COUNT(m.id) AS matches,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal) OR (m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(m.id) AS win_pct,
        AVG(CASE WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal ELSE m.away_team_goal END) AS avg_goals
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_1
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, l.id
)
SELECT
    coach_id,
    matches,
    win_pct,
    avg_goals
FROM (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_id ORDER BY win_pct DESC) AS rn
    FROM coach_stats
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY league_id, win_pct DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH PremierLeagueTeams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.team_api_id
    FROM "Team" t
    JOIN "Match" m ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
    JOIN "League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'
),
TeamWidthData AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.team_api_id,
        ta.date,
        strftime('%Y', ta.date) as year,
        ta.defenceTeamWidth
    FROM "Team_Attributes" ta
    JOIN PremierLeagueTeams plt ON ta.team_api_id = plt.team_api_id
),
WithGrowth AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        year,
        defenceTeamWidth,
        LAG(defenceTeamWidth) OVER (PARTITION BY team_api_id ORDER BY year) as prev_year_width,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY team_api_id ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_count
    FROM TeamWidthData
)
SELECT 
    team_api_id,
    year,
    defenceTeamWidth,
    ROUND(CASE WHEN prev_year_width IS NOT NULL THEN ((defenceTeamWidth - prev_year_width) * 100.0 / prev_year_width) ELSE NULL END, 2) as growth_rate
FROM WithGrowth
WHERE year IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y', date)
    FROM "Team_Attributes"
    ORDER BY CAST(strftime('%Y', date) AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
ORDER BY team_api_id, year;

votes.sql: SELECT ppa.player_api_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ppa.date) AS evaluation_count FROM "Player_Attributes" ppa WHERE ppa.overall_rating > 80 GROUP BY ppa.player_api_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ppa.date) >= 2

WITH epl AS (
    SELECT l.id FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League' AND c.name = 'England'
),
qualifying_players AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    WHERE pa.overall_rating > 80
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
team_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.home_team_api_id AS team_id, hp.player_id
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN epl ON m.league_id = epl.id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '2015%'
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES (home_player_1),(home_player_2),(home_player_3),(home_player_4),(home_player_5),(home_player_6),(home_player_7),(home_player_8),(home_player_9),(home_player_10),(home_player_11)) AS hp(player_id)
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT m.away_team_api_id AS team_id, ap.player_id
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN epl ON m.league_id = epl.id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '2015%'
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES (away_player_1),(away_player_2),(away_player_3),(away_player_4),(away_player_5),(away_player_6),(away_player_7),(away_player_8),(away_player_9),(away_player_10),(away_player_11)) AS ap(player_id)
),
qualifying_team_players AS (
    SELECT tp.team_id
    FROM team_players tp
    JOIN qualifying_players qp ON tp.player_id = qp.player_api_id
    GROUP BY tp.team_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name AS club, 0 AS total_transfer_cost
FROM Team t
JOIN qualifying_team_players qtp ON t.team_api_id = qtp.team_id
GROUP BY t.team_long_name;
